comparisons.name: notification-center-light
comparisons.description: The Do Not Disturb switch of Notification Center's Today view, off, Aqua: the only switch in the reference set. No text in the crop.

comparisons.name: notification-center-dark

comparisons.name: on-light
comparisons.description: Off and on at rest, Aqua. No screenshot shows a switch that is on.

the knob is at the leading end when off
